versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Moths that brew Heat on a Lamp by casting spells: stop at exactly 7 for big End of Turn buffs, or go over to Flare and fire every Flare effect.
Heat carries into fights, where some Moths Stoke it further and can Flare mid-fight.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Clearer timing: Heat resets before Start of Turn, The Old Lady stops Flares only while recruiting, the Hawk-moth drains before it Stokes, Brass and the Noctuid name their targets.
The Uncertain now makes a random-dose Phial and The Herald Stokes on Tier up, to give both their character.

stop_reason: 3 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
